chunk_map.heading: Hear every idea before anything gets averaged

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L4 "So hear every idea first, written down with a name on it, before any agent sees the pile." and L6 "builds that in": closest to a loose referent; 'that' resolves to the sentence-initial 'hear every idea first' and 'the pile' to 'everyone's ideas' in L4. Harm (unresolved referent on a wall) absent.
L6 "from Liberating Structures" names an external source by title; no callback to another file by position (grep of 'lecture|earlier|above' in body = 0).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'the X you did/saw/caught' construction; L8 "the same people it always did" is a general claim, not a beat reference.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.

rules_evaluated.evidence: Single chunk carries a full claim (L4 "hear every idea first... before any agent sees the pile"); not a wait-state.
Header L1 "Hear every idea before anything gets averaged" vs L4 "hand back the middle" and "hear every idea first": body delivers the header's claim, nothing contradicts it.

Closest: L6 "Then pairs, then fours, then a few people share" is a sequence of concrete steps, not an empty-leg triplet; no 'Not X. Not Y.', no superlative, no number+retraction (L6 'The numbers are group sizes, not minutes' is a clarification, not a retraction).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L4 'the pile' / 'averaged' are ordinary words; no surface-as-noun, beat, mood, compendium in body (grep).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Bold count in body = 0 (view bold absent; L4-8 plain prose). Within budget of <=1.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: slide file included by its lecture; section presence is a renderer concern, no phase-less section here

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js --file curriculum/slides/one-two-four-all.md -> OK, Phase/Step numbering consistent; body has no Phase/Step refs.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/slides/one-two-four-all.md -> OK, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/slides/one-two-four-all.md -> oversized: 0 (limits 210 words / 6 bullets); body is 3 paragraphs, 0 bullets.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L1 "Hear every idea before anything gets averaged" is a claim-shaped heading, correct for a lecture slide.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L8 "Merging the pile now takes an agent seconds. Choosing which idea survives it takes the same people it always did." reads like a kicker but adds a new object (the choosing stays human) rather than restating the header, so it earns its slot (class c not met).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: maintainer STATUS records a full rebuild (L12); no header-only rename provenance note

notes: Single-chunk slide file. Accept-notes in maintainer block: STATUS and Fidelity guard (simulation training, not taught); none cover a body passage I flagged.
